site.source: <brief file> p. N: only without a site folder, the site's outline as [[lon, lat], ...] traced from the brief's site plan

places.source: <brief file> p. N: only without a structure plan, [{"name": ..., "kind": "gateway" or "centre", "at": [lon, lat], "holds": ...}]

routes.source: <brief file> p. N: only without a structure plan, [{"name": ..., "level": "main" or "local", "mode": "<words>", "via": [place names or [lon, lat]]}]

hub.source: <brief file> p. N: the structure plan's centre the brief or programme asks a hub for; leave null when none asks

main_stop.source: <brief file> p. N: the structure plan's gateway or centre that is the main public-transport stop; leave null when there is none

main_stop_mode.source: <brief file> p. N: rail, bus or tram at the main stop

walk_limits_m.source: <brief file> p. N, else a cited norm (its name and page)

car_access.source: <brief file> p. N: the gateways where cars may enter (may stay empty)

no_car_link.source: <brief file> p. N: pairs of gateways no car route may join

bike_destinations.source: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: why

stops.source: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: why

garages.source: <brief file> p. N, or assumption: why

modes.source: <brief file> p. N: only where the structure plan's words are unclear

scale.source: <brief file> p. N: the site plan scale, as a number (3000 for 1:3,000)

labels.source: assumption: the legend in the brief's language; English when left out
